findings.current: Earlier, I had offered to carry him along with his sister. He had flatly refused.
findings.defect: The translation omits that Jin offered to carry Socheon and his sister on his back.
findings.rationale: The verb 업혀 가다 explicitly describes being carried on someone’s back, not merely being carried by an unspecified method.
findings.replacement: Earlier, I had offered to carry both him and his sister on my back. He had flatly refused.

findings.defect: The translation changes something Gong Yacheong foresaw or expected into something that could not have been avoided.
findings.rationale: 예견된 일이오 means the deterioration was foreseen or expected. It does not itself claim inevitability, especially since Gong Yacheong immediately confirms that a treatment exists.

findings.current: Everyone stared at Han Yeop in surprise.
findings.defect: The translation omits Han Yeop’s resolute delivery and the explicit causal link between his tone and everyone’s surprise.
findings.rationale: 단호한 말투에 states that the others react specifically to the resolute tone in which he declares his disobedience.
findings.replacement: The firmness in his voice made everyone stare at Han Yeop in surprise.

findings.defect: The translation drops the deliberate repetition of the condition about not leaving Gong Yacheong behind and again omits the specified piggyback mechanism.
findings.rationale: 두고 갈 수 없으면 repeats the preceding challenge after the narration beat, while 업고 갈래 explicitly asks whether Han Yeop will carry Gong Yacheong on his back.
findings.replacement: “If we can’t leave him behind, then are you going to carry him on your back?”

summary: Faithful overall, with four minor losses involving physical carrying details, modality, delivery, and deliberate repetition.
